blocks.text: Agreed on holding the investor-relations line for now. Michelle Rose will keep it marked in the draft so it is easy to pick up once you have decided.
Here is how I would take the {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} messaging from here:

items: 1. Michelle Rose sends you the first draft on Friday, with the investor-relations line flagged.
2. We hold a short call early next week to walk through it together.
3. We settle the held line on that call and lock the rest.

blocks.text: Sign-off on the final wording stays with you, Mary Frank. Send me two or three windows for a call next week and I will confirm one.
